Alex — thanks for the productive demo last week. As discussed, I've pulled together a lean Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft so we can align evaluation steps, procurement gating, and a realistic close runway for Dedicated / Private reservation. Attached: MAP_Medtronix_v0.1.pdf (stub).

High level asks from our side:
- Target go-live window you want to hit (your engineering/product timeline)
- Procurement contact and preferred PO/contract cadence
- Your acceptance criteria for pilot -> production (latency/throughput/quality thresholds)

Suggested MAP milestones (proposal):
1) Eval kickoff (2-week testbed): week of 2026-05-11 — Redwood provides 4x H100 test pool + baseline prompts/dataset
2) Eval review + sizing decision: 2026-05-25 — decide on committed pool size (dedicated/private)
3) PO & procurement: target 2026-05-28 — PO submitted to hit GPU lead windows
4) Hardware procurement + staging: 12–18 week lead for H100 dedicated pool (contingency: interim A10/A100 burst)
5) Onboarding & acceptance: target Q4 ramp (dates TBD after procurement)

Sizing note (very high level): for production inference with your 95th percentile latency target (~150ms) and expected qps patterns, a conservative first committed pool is 8x H100 (dedicated) with a small KV/prefix cache. We recommend a short eval on 4x H100 to validate burst behavior and latency SLOs. Marissa will share a sizing rationale worksheet.

Please confirm your preferred close date and loop in procurement. If medtronix needs a faster path we can propose a staged commitment (short PO for eval capacity, then scale).

Best,

Alex / team — following up with a pragmatic sizing + evaluation playbook. I dropped a short worksheet (Sizing_Rationale_v1.xlsx) into the Drive link. Highlights:

Evaluator/testbed (2 weeks) — objective: validate P95 latency < 150ms for typical prompt mix, embedding throughput >= 300 qps for batch inference, and output quality for 3 representative prompts.
- Testbed config (recommended): 4x H100 (single-shot inference, production prompt set), 1x small cache node, default batching config from Redwood Optimize.
- Production commit (recommended baseline): 8x H100 reserved (dedicated pool) if eval meets SLOs. Rationale: headroom for burst traffic, KV cache hit-rate assumptions, and model variant flexibility.
- Alternative faster path: 12x A10 / A100 combination for faster procurement (lead times ~4–6 weeks) as an intermediate while H100 procurement runs.

Acceptance criteria (pass to commit):
- P95 latency <= 150ms for 95% of sampled requests
- End-to-end availability during 48-hour soak >= 99.5%
- Throughput baseline: sustainable 200 qps for gen tokens at observed batch sizes

Estimated commercial ask (ballpark):
- Itemized quote: 4x H100 test pool (2-week) — credit applied on first committed month if deal closes within 30 days
- 8x H100 reserved pool — lead time 12–18 weeks, depends on procurement channel and region

Attachments: Sizing_Rationale_v1.xlsx (worksheet)

Action items I recommend we capture in the MAP doc:
- Redwood to provision 4x H100 testbed week of 5/11
- Medtronix to provide final acceptance prompts and SOC2 evidence request list by 5/14
- Decision checkpoint on 5/25; PO submission target 5/28 to meet H100 lead windows

I'll join the procurement sync. If procurement needs an itemized rate card to circulate to finance, we can provide a draft quote by Friday.

—Marissa

Alex / Sara — quick procurement + lead-time summary from infra/ops: 
- H100 dedicated pools: realistic procurement & delivery window is 12–18 weeks from signed PO (depends on region & supplier batch).
- Faster alternative: A100/A10 reserved pools (4–8 weeks) can bridge production if you need earlier capacity. We can also support a commitment where a portion is staged (e.g., 4x H100 + 8x A10 interim) and convert/remap capacity when H100 arrives.

Recommended MAP adjustments (calendarized):
- 2026-05-11: Eval start (Redwood provisions 4x H100 test pool)
- 2026-05-18: Mid-eval check (initial metrics)
- 2026-05-25: Decision checkpoint: commit to reserved configuration (Medtronix sign-off)
- 2026-05-28: Target PO submission to finance (this is the critical close date to hit our current H100 tranche)
- 2026-09-20: Earliest realistic production-ready date if PO submitted on 5/28 and no supply disruption

Next steps:
1) Sara — if you can confirm procurement docs (MSA vs PO) and a single recipient email for finance, we will issue an itemized quote and a DocuSign envelope for signature by 5/20.
2) Evelyn/Marissa — provision testbed on 5/11 and share test dataset + runbook.

If Medtronix prefers, I can draft a two-stage commercial that shows credits for testbed and a conversion mechanism when H100 inventory arrives.

Regards,
